image_prompt: Catherine the Great as a cyberpunk anime character, rendered in sleek futuristic style. Long blonde hair styled in an elaborate upswept arrangement with holographic strands interwoven, catching neon light. Her eyes hold quiet intellectual awakening and detached observation. Rendered with clean anime linework, sharp contrasts between pale skin and dark backgrounds, cyberpunk color palette of cool whites, golds, and electric blues. The overall aesthetic balances rigid historical formality with futuristic technological elements.
